'''Ray Franks''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 3rd at [[December 1999 Greensboro tournament]] on 5 December 1999, according to Leonard Mitchell's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d138">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-06-greensboro-north-carolina-12-05-99d138/ greensboro-north-carolina-12-05-99], DeckTech (Leonard "Master Yoda" Mitchell, 6 December 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-12-06-greensboro-north-carolina-12-05-99d138/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
